queries.query:
from(bucket: "metrics-loadtest")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "vus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_mode"] == "testing")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["tenant_id"])
  |> yield(name: "Test VUs")

from(bucket: "metrics-loadtest")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "vus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_mode"] == "real")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> yield(name: "Real VUs")

import "regexp"

pattern = regexp.compile(v:v.AppPodRgx)

from(bucket: "metrics-nodes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["pod"] =~ /keycloak-\d-\d/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["container"] == v.AppName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["cpu"] == "total")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "pod"]) 
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "metrics-loadtest")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "http_req_failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["tenant_mode"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "metrics-loadtest")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == v.MetricName)
//   |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value" and r["name"] == "login")
  |> group(columns: ["tenant_mode"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 5.0 }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] < 100)

from(bucket: "metrics-nodes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "usage_user")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["cpu"] == "cpu-total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "k8s-worker0" or r["host"] == "k8s-worker1")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
